name: Anguilla eVisa / Visitor Entry

requirements.blocker_text: Must hold nationality of a country on the eVisa-eligible list, or already hold a valid UK, US, or Canadian visa (which permits entry without a separate Anguilla visa). Nationals who are not eVisa-eligible and lack a qualifying visa must instead apply for an Entry Clearance Visa at a British Embassy or High Commission before travel.
Single-entry eVisa permits a stay of up to 90 days and must be used within 90 days of issue; multiple-entry eVisa is valid for 1 year with each individual stay capped at 90 consecutive days.

evidence_required.document: Completed online eVisa application (apply, pay, print)
Visa fee: US$140 (single entry) or US$250 (multiple entry)

outcome.duration_length: up to 90 days per entry; multiple-entry eVisa valid 1 year from issue

sources.title: Government of Anguilla -- eVisa Portal: online visitor visa application, fees (US$140 single / US$250 multiple entry + US$20 processing), validity, 15-20 business day processing

Government of Anguilla -- Visas & Travel: visa-required nationals must apply via British Embassy/High Commission; UK-visa holders and diplomatic passport holders exempt; eVisa processing 8-10 business days

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Anguilla's initial build (first country built this session that is a British Overseas Territory rather than a sovereign state -- see ai_belonger_status_descent.json's notes for the full explanation of how this changes the category mapping for ancestry/family/settled routes). 'nationality_eligible_for_evisa' is modelled as a boolean flag, not a literal enumerated country list -- the specific eVisa-eligible-country list was not independently retrieved in this pass. The two tier-1 sources give conflicting processing-time figures (eVisa portal: 15-20 business days; Visas & Travel page: 8-10 business days) -- both cited as found, not silently reconciled. Entry Clearance Visa (the embassy-based route for non-eVisa-eligible nationals) is mentioned but not modelled as its own route: no fee or processing detail for it was found at tier-1 in this pass.
